descriptionChirho: A disposition of self-seeking partisanship, factional strife, or rivalry motivated by personal gain rather than genuine concern; encompasses both singular and plural forms across all cases. Multilingual translations confirm a unified meaning: spa ambición egoísta / rivalidad / rivalidades, arb تَحَزُّبٍ/تَحَزُّبًا/تَحَزُّباتٌ (tahazzub, 'partisanship/factionalism'), kor 이기심/이기심들 (igisim, 'selfishness'), swa ubinafsi ('selfishness'), hin स्वार्थ/सवर्थिक्त (svarth, 'selfishness'). S68105 is merely the plural nominative variant of S68102; no target language distinguishes a separate lexical meaning.
